scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('index.html','dist/index.html'); if(fs.existsSync('logo.png')) fs.copyFileSync('logo.png','dist/logo.png'); if(fs.existsSync('logo-heritage.png')) fs.copyFileSync('logo-heritage.png','dist/logo-heritage.png'); if(fs.existsSync('public')) fs.cpSync('public','dist/public',{recursive:true}); console.log('Sukaregang Discovery built successfully for Vercel!');"
